test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e71219560b5499d1a2f9cb7e51c08eb672952dadaf494c8bcebd748c76a9e9.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

Elements above the diagonal line shift one step upward clockwise.

The elements below the diagonal line shift one step downward clockwise.

The left diagonal corner element interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93e5a539eda72ab1a5c99a9adf28f667454f6793d57ac722041dbd59ca3beef8.png] 

2) Second box series →

Top three elements above the diagonal line and top right corner element shift anticlockwise

Top three elements below the diagonal line and bottom left corner element shift clockwise.

The rest elements shift clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4e10027d638b8660e7ff70bd3274f6df0ef88d7308e8750d1e6728b994b2395.png] 

 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7a6ef5da2effa6cdc2ba3042be97c3145a9ada89f9475f17dcec86e397ebdef.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
